text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Oka Sho marks the first battle of the
Triple Tiara tour. It's held at Hanshin
Racecourse, the
same place where Fine
Motion made her debut.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Oh boy, this year's Triple Tiara is about
to begin!
I wonder who'll take the Oka
Sho this year!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
I loooved seeing last year's winner
achieve her dream. It looks like this
year's race will have its
fair share of
drama too!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Oooh...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Right?! The atmosphere is completely
different
from when I made my debut.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I guess that goes to show how special
the Oka
Sho—one of the Classics—is.

text_block_list.name: Trembling Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I've come all this way. I have to win... I
just have to.

text_block_list.name: Trembling Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I have to live up to everyone's
expectations! Come on! I
can do this!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...It's strange.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
She looked so uneasy, and yet her eyes
were
gleaming so brilliantly.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The races in the Triple Tiara can only be
entered by Umamusume in their classic
year. Victory claimed in such
circumstances must taste all the
sweeter.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: A once-in-a-lifetime race...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: That's right. It makes sense.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Today's winner will be she who shines
brightest. I
can feel it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion looks especially serious as
she softly utters those words. With her
resolve renewed,
there's one concern I
should convey to her...

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text:
Hey... That Fine Motion girl over there...
she's like
descended from royalty or
something, right?

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
Oh come on, as if she's—wait, you
actually mean
it? For real?! You think
it'd be okay to snap some
pics?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just as I feared, her lineage is drawing
attention
and creating a stir among the
spectators.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As for Fine Motion herself, however...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
It's a pleasure to meet you all. I
appreciate your
support today.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Wow, she's so beautiful...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In an instant, Fine Motion captivates the 
spectators and turns their curious gazes
into ones of admiration. Our earlier
conversation comes to
mind.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
You're worried about everyone looking
at me?
That won't be a problem.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
After all, the fact they're looking is
precisely what
gives shape to me as
"Fine Motion."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I'm grateful to all of you for your
interest
in me. I
hope you enjoy the race with all
your hearts.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: She's so dignified...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Now, it's my time to shine! ♪
